title: StaX-Net: Stackelberg Interleaved Asymmetric Network for Cross-Modality Medical Image Translation
abstract: arXiv:2610.34214v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cross-modality medical image translation is challenged by anatomically inconsistent synthesis that can compromise clinical diagnosis. We propose StaX-Net, a Stackelberg interleaved asymmetric network that incorporates a partially coupled encoder-discriminator structure, and a 2D feature aggregation and spatial transformation (FAST) layer that distills target-supervised priors under the learning using privileged information paradigm. The shared blocks between the generator and discriminator enhance architectural feature alignment. To stabilize the leader-follower training, a Stackelberg-inspired asymmetric optimization scheme employs explicit shared-parameter freezing and asymmetric learning rates. The FAST layer distills target-domain priors during training and applies a source-only transform at inference. This constrains the synthesis process through target-informed feature representations relative to standard generative architectures

translated_title: StaX-Net：面向跨模态医学图像翻译的Stackelberg交错非对称网络
translated_abstract: 跨模态医学图像翻译面临解剖结构不一致合成的挑战，这可能损害临床诊断。我们提出了StaX-Net，一种Stackelberg交错非对称网络，它包含部分耦合的编码器-判别器结构，以及一个在特权信息学习范式下提炼目标监督先验的二维特征聚合与空间变换（FAST）层。生成器与判别器之间的共享模块增强了架构特征对齐。为了稳定领导者-跟随者训练，一种受Stackelberg启发的非对称优化方案采用显式的共享参数冻结和非对称学习率。FAST层在训练期间提炼目标域先验，并在推理时应用仅基于源域的变换。相对于标准生成架构，这通过目标信息引导的特征表示来约束合成过程。
tldr: 提出StaX-Net，通过Stackelberg非对称优化方案与FAST层蒸馏目标域先验，约束跨模态医学图像翻译的合成过程，提升解剖结构一致性。
en_tdlr: StaX-Net, a Stackelberg-inspired asymmetric network with a FAST layer, improves anatomical consistency in cross-modality medical image translation by distilling target-domain priors during training.
